<div data-version="3.0.0" data-hash="76c6d1cd6eae84bb3756b2b824dccab9"><strong><span style="font-size: 1.5em">引言</span></strong></div>
<div class="document">
<div class="section">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">前面几章我们走过了园区网络与广域网络，本章进入数据通信设备最密集、技术演进最激进的场景<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">数据中心网络。全章围绕四个问题展开：什么是数据中心网络、数据中心的物理网络如何组网、逻辑网络如何叠加、以太网如何从<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">有损<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">走向<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">智能无损<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">数据中心是指安置计算机系统及相关部件的设施，例如电信和储存系统。数据中心一般包含冗余和备用电源、冗余数据通信连接、环境控制（比如空调、灭火器）设备、监控设备和各种安全设备。</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">理解数据中心，一个直观的类比是<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">水<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：数据<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">算力好比水资源，数据中心是蓄水的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">水库<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，运营商网络如同<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">河流<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">湖泊<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，园区网络相当于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">自来水管网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，而终端则是最终用水的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">水龙头<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。算力从数据中心出发，经由运营商网络与园区网络，最终抵达每一台终端。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">数据中心的分层架构</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">数据中心的内部结构可以自下而上分为五层，从土建配套一直贯穿到业务应用。</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="398" height="339.8223622047244" id="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261021150134294-991686711.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>

<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">数据中心的发展趋势</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">数据中心的发展呈现四大趋势：物理机<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">—<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">虚拟机<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">—<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">云化数据中心<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">—<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">服务化数据中心的持续演进；从单云走向混合云；从单中心走向多地多中心；算力密度和强度持续升级。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">表<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 2<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　数据中心四大发展趋势</span></span></span></p>

<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">混合云已经成为企业的主流选择。企业混合云策略的分布如下：单公有云<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> + <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">单私有云占<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 11%<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，单公有云<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> + <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">多私有云占<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 13%<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，多公有云<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> + <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">单私有云占<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 43%<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，多公有云<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> + <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">多私有云占<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 33%——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">超过七成的企业采用了多公有云组合。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">数据中心网络架构：从三层到大二层，再到 Spine-Leaf</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">数据中心网络的架构史，本质上是一部围绕<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">“<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">二层边界画在哪里<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">”<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">展开的博弈史：先有三层分工，再有二三层分界上移，最终由<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CLOS <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">架构给出答案。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">传统三层网络架构</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">传统数据中心网络采用经典的三层结构：接入层负责物理机和虚拟机的接入、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">VLAN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的标记以及流量的二层转发；汇聚层的汇聚交换机连接接入交换机，同时提供其他服务；核心层对进出数据中心的流量进行高速转发。每个<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> PoD<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Point of Delivery<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，交付点）都是独立的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> VLAN<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">PoD <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">内通过生成树协议防环。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="548" height="325.29385826771653" id="2" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261021150134306-1863003159.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 2<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　三层网络架构示意图</span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">三层架构的两大局限</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">局限一：无法支撑大二层网络构建。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">云计算资源池化要求虚拟机自由迁移且不改变<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与网关，这就需要搭建大二层网络。传统三层架构只能将二三层分界上移至核心交换机，核心以下全为二层，汇聚层的网关功能失效，最终演进出无汇聚层的二层架构。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="548" height="340.2136482939632" id="3" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261021150134307-484341689.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 3<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　大二层网络架构</span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">局限二：无法支持流量（尤其是东西向流量）的无阻塞转发。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">传统数据中心以南北向流量为主，而云数据中心因业务分布式部署和大数据并行计算，东西向流量占比升至<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 90%<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。传统三层架构为南北向流量设计，东西向流量需经汇聚层、核心层绕行转发，受收敛比和<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> STP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">技术影响性能衰减，降低了网络可用性，增加了扩展难度和部署成本。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Spine-Leaf：来自 CLOS 架构的答案</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">一个基于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 3 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">级<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CLOS <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">架构的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Spine-Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络，每个<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">交换机的上行链路数都等于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Spine <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">交换机的数量，每个<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Spine <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">交换机的下行链路数都等于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">交换机的数量。可以说，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Spine <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">交换机和<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">交换机之间是以全网状（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Full-Mesh<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）方式连接的。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="525" height="229.42194225721784" id="4" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261021150134300-1400583755.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 4<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Spine-Leaf<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络架构</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Spine-Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">架构的三大优势使其成为当前数据中心的主流选择。</span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">表<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 4<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　三层架构与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Spine-Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">架构对比</span></span></span></span></span></p>

<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">数据中心网络的技术演进</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">大二层与流量的需求推动了数据中心网络技术的代际更替，演进路线上有四类代表性技术：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">xSTP<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、虚拟机框类技术、二层多路径类技术（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Layer 2 Multi-Path<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">L2MP<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）与三层网络虚拟化类技术（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Network Virtualization over Layer 3<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">NVo3<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">），此外跨设备链路聚合作为接入侧的补充方案也广泛部署。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">xSTP：最朴素的防环手段</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络发展初期，局域网通过构建无环的二层网络并利用广播寻址，方式简单有效。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">xSTP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">技术用于进一步保障实际使用中不产生环路：在环形网络中，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">xSTP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">会阻塞其中一条链路，把<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">环<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">变成<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">树<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，避免报文无限循环。但<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> xSTP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的缺陷同样突出：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">收敛速度慢<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：链路或交换机故障时需重新计算生成树与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MAC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">表，根节点故障还需重新选举；</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">次优转发路径<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：非根交换机之间更短的路径会被<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> xSTP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">阻塞，流量只能绕行更长路径；</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">链路利用率低<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：被阻塞的链路平时处于不可用状态，仅在故障时启用；</span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">不支持 ECMP<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：三层网络可通过<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ECMP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">实现等价多路径转发，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">xSTP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">没有类似机制；</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">广播风暴风险<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：部分故障场景下仍可能成环，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">xSTP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">对此无能为力；</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络规模小<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：通过<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> VLAN ID <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">标识租户，而<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> VLAN ID <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">仅<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 12 bit<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，最多支持<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 4096 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">个<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> VLAN<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">；</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">缺乏双归接入机制<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：服务器双归接入两台<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> xSTP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">交换机必然成环，双归被迫退化为单归。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">虚拟机框：把多台设备变成一台</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">虚拟机框技术将多台设备的控制平面整合为一台统一的逻辑设备，该逻辑设备拥有统一的管理<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">地址，在各种<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> L2/L3 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">协议中表现为一个整体。典型实现包括华为的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> iStack/CSS<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、思科的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> VSS <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">和新华三的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IRF2<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="514" height="339.9685039370079" id="5" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261021150134281-252705418.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 5<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　通过堆叠构建无环网络</span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">虚拟机框解决了环路问题，但控制平面集中的代价同样明显：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">扩展性受限<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">主交换机负责整个系统的控制平面，扩展性受制于主交换机性能；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">升级丢包<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">重启升级必然导致控制平面中断，造成较长时间丢包；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">可靠性不足<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">主交换机故障可能引起较长时间丢包甚至整机停止运行；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">带宽浪费率高<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">设备间状态交互与数据转发的专门线路通常占用设备总带宽的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 10%<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">～<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">15%<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">L2MP：给二层网络引入路由</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">参考三层网络路由技术，链路状态路由协议要求网络中每个节点都可寻址。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">L2MP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">类技术因此为每台设备添加可寻址标识，代表协议有两个：标准<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> L2MP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">协议<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">多链接透明互联协议（TRILL）<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，采用<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MAC in TRILL in MAC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">封装，在原始以太帧头外增加<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> TRILL <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">帧头与外层以太帧头；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">最短路径桥接协议（SPB）<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，采用<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MAC in MAC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">封装，直接使用<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">作为寻址标识。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">L2MP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">引入了三层路由能力，但应用受限：租户数量有限<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——TRILL <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">仍以<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> VLAN ID <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">标识租户，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">12 bit <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">仅支持<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 4000 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">户左右的租户规模；机制不完善<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——TRILL <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> OAM <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与组播机制长期未形成正式标准；部署成本高<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">需要升级换代转发芯片，存量旧芯片设备无法支持。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">跨设备链路聚合：专治双归接入</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">跨设备链路聚合技术对两台设备进行控制平面的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">弱耦合<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：不要求设备间所有状态信息完全同步，仅同步链路聚合的相关信息，从而解决终端双归属接入问题。典型实现有思科的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> VPC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Juniper <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MC-LAG<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，华为的对应方案即<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> M-LAG<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。该技术可解决双归接入、且两台设备可独立升级，但只聚焦链路聚合本身，无法解决多租户等核心需求。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">NVo3：叠加网络的胜利</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">NVo3 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">是一项以<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IT <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">厂商为推动主体、旨在摆脱对传统物理网络架构依赖的叠加网络技术<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">在物理网络之上构建一层虚拟网络拓扑。报文由发送方<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> NVE<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（网络虚拟化边缘，物理交换机或虚拟交换机）通过封装协议打入隧道，经<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">路由网络转发，再由对端<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> NVE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">解封装交付接收方；终端设备为<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> VM <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">或物理服务器。代表性封装协议包括<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> VXLAN<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">NVGRE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> STT<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="548" height="151.26267716535435" id="6" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261021150134286-1644513821.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 6<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">NVo3<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">类技术模型</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">NVo3 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">复用成熟的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">转发机制、适配存量网络，并通过隧道封装支持海量租户隔离，成为当前数据中心的主流方案。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">表<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 5<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　数据中心网络技术演进路线对比</span></span></span></p>

<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">数据中心的物理网络</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">架构选型确定之后，工程落地要回答的是另外三个问题：设备角色如何划分、链路如何互连、收敛比控制在什么范围。</span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">推荐组网：Spine 与三类 Leaf</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">数据中心物理网络遵循<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Spine-Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">架构，功能节点分为四类：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Spine <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">是骨干节点，通过高速接口连接各个<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">功能节点；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Border Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">提供数据中心外部流量接入功能，用于连接外部路由器或传输设备；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Server Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">提供虚拟化服务器、非虚拟化服务器等计算资源接入功能；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Service Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">提供防火墙和负载均衡等增值业务（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">VAS<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）接入功能。一个<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Fabric <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">是一个<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SDN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">控制器管理的网络故障域，可以包含一个或多个<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Spine-Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络结构；多活网关旁挂<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Border Leaf<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">PE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">连接<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> External Network<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="455" height="339.6616272965879" id="7" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261021150134298-889036375.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 7<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　推荐的物理组网方式</span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">表<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 6<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　物理网络四类功能节点</span></span></span></p>
<table>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">节点角色</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">功能定位</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Spine</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">骨干节点，通过高速接口连接各个<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">功能节点</span></span></span></span></span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Border Leaf</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">提供外部流量接入功能，连接外部路由器或传输设备</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Server Leaf</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">提供虚拟化<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">非虚拟化服务器等计算资源接入功能</span></span></span></span></span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Service Leaf</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">提供防火墙、负载均衡等增值业务接入网络的功能</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">物理网络部署要点</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Fabric <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">内部采用三层路由接口互连并使用<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> OSPF <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">或<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> BGP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">协议，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Spine <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">之间通过<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IP ECMP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">实现等价多路径转发。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">节点推荐使用<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> M-LAG <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">双活部署（可靠性要求不高的场景也可使用虚拟机框类技术），服务器通过<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Eth-Trunk <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">接入。部署的关键参数是收敛比：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">下行总带宽与上行总带宽之比建议控制在<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 1:2<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">～<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1:9<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">数据中心的逻辑网络</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">逻辑网络与物理网络解耦：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Underlay<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 是物理网络，负责报文的实际传输，提供带宽与时延保障；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Overlay<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">是在<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Underlay <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">上叠加的逻辑网络，基于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> NVo3 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">技术构建，解决大二层与多租户问题。两者解耦后，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SDN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">控制器可以灵活部署业务，实现多租户隔离与大二层需求。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">以太网从有损走向智能无损</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">AI <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与大数据把以太网推到了一个新的关口：它必须像专网一样做到近乎零丢包，否则再强的算力也会被网络拖住。</span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">TCP/IP 协议栈的两大瓶颈</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">进入<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> AI <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">时代，传统<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> TCP/IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络成为算力释放的瓶颈，问题集中在两点。其一，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">TCP/IP 协议栈处理带来数十微秒的时延<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">TCP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">协议栈在接收<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">发送报文时，内核每次切换上下文都需要耗费<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 5<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">～<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">10 μs<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，另外还需要至少<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 3 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">次的数据复制和依赖<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CPU <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">进行协议封装。其二，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">TCP 协议栈处理导致服务器 CPU 负载居高不下<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：网络规模越大、带宽越高，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">CPU <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">在收发数据时的调度负担就越大。对比测试显示，同样是<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 40 Gbit/s <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">TCP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">方式下<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CPU <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">占用率高达<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 100%<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、网络时延为毫秒级；而<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> RDMA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">方式下<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CPU <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">占用率仅<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 5%<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、网络时延降至<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 10 μs <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">以下。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">RDMA：绕过内核的直接内存访问</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">RDMA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">是一种直接内存访问技术，它将数据直接从一台计算机的内存传输到另一台计算机，这使得数据从一个系统快速移动到远程系统存储器，无须双方操作系统的介入，也无须经过处理器处理，最终达到高带宽、低时延和低资源占用率的效果。</span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="498" height="340.04062992125984" id="8" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261021150134264-774730113.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 8<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">RDMA<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">TCP/IP<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">工作机制对比</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">RDMA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">有三种实现方式。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">IB（InfiniBand）<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">是专为<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> RDMA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">设计的网络，从硬件级别保证可靠传输，具有极高的吞吐量和极低的时延，但成本高且是私有协议，不适合大规模互联网数据中心。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">IWARP<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">允许在<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> TCP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">上执行<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> RDMA<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，实际应用需要支持<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IWARP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的特殊网卡，性能一般。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">RoCE<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">允许应用通过以太网实现远程内存访问，将<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> RDMA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">运用到以太网及交换机上，需要支持<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> RoCE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的特殊网卡，目前有<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> RoCE v1<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（链路层协议）和<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> RoCE v2<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（网络层协议）两个版本。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">表<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 7<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">RDMA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">三种实现方式对比</span></span></span></span></span></p>

<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">丢包为什么对 RDMA 是致命的</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">RDMA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络对丢包极其敏感：丢包率达到<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 0.001 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">量级时吞吐率即开始明显下降，到<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 0.01 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">时吞吐率趋近于零。更关键的是，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">RoCE v2 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">基于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> UDP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">协议、无重传机制，一旦丢包需要上层应用重传<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">整个 message<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（而非单个报文），代价极高。因此<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> RDMA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络必须依靠无损网络支撑。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">从时延构成看，网络总时延分为静态时延与动态时延：静态时延包括数据串行时延（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1 ns/B<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">10G <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">口）、光电传播时延（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">50 ns/m<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）与设备转发时延（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">500 ns<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">），量级稳定可控；动态时延包括内部排队时延（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">0<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">～<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ms <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">级）与丢包重传时延（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">0<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">～<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">s <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">级），一旦发生拥塞或丢包，时延将出现数量级的恶化。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">表<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 8<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　网络时延构成</span></span></span></p>

</table>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Incast：CLOS 网络的固有挑战</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">数据中心流行的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CLOS <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络架构采用<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Spine-Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">组网，存在<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> many-to-one <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> all-to-all <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">两种流量模型，无法避免<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Incast <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">现象<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">这是造成数据中心网络丢包的主要原因。分布式架构需要服务器之间大量协作，协作方式一般采用<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MAP/REDUCE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">过程：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">MAP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">阶段将大任务分解为多个子任务，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">REDUCE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">阶段搜集多个计算节点的处理结果进行汇总，此时网络流量呈现<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Incast <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">特征<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">即多对一的通信模式。大量服务器节点同时向同一客户端发送数据，短时流量激增会导致客户端所连交换机的出口拥塞，服务器感知丢包后重传，应用还需等全部数据到齐才能发起下一个请求。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">应对之道分两层。对 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">many-to-one<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">模型，交换机<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">必须提前向源端发送抑制流量信号控制流量，同时保留足够<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Buffer <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">以在源端降速前接纳报文<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">这些由拥塞控制机制完成，此外还需链路级流量控制兜底。对<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">all-to-all<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">模型，要实现无丢包、无时延损失、无吞吐量损失，需引入负载分担，控制多个<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> one-to-one <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">流量不在交换机上形成交叉。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">流量控制：以太 PAUSE 与 PFC</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">以太 PAUSE 机制<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">IEEE 802.3 Annex 31B<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）是以太网的基本流量控制功能：当下游设备发现接收能力小于上游设备的发送能力时，主动向上游发送<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> PAUSE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">帧，要求暂停流量发送，等待一定时间后再继续。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">PAUSE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">帧由目的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MAC<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">6 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">字节）、源<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MAC<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">6 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">字节）、长度<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">类型（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">字节）、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">MAC Control opcode<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">字节）、包含时间参数的控制参数、保留字段与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> FCS<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">4 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">字节）构成。它的缺点是不区分优先级<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">暂停的是整条链路。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">PFC（基于优先级的流控）<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">在此基础上前进一大步：允许在一条以太网链路上创建<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 8 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">个虚拟通道，为每条虚拟通道指定一个优先等级，允许单独暂停和重启其中任意一条虚拟通道，同时允许其他虚拟通道的流量无中断通过。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">PFC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">帧中，优先级使能向量（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Priority enable vector<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）指明哪些队列需要暂停，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Time(0)<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">～<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Time(7) <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">共<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 16 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">字节为各队列分别设定暂停时长，加上目的地址、源地址各<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 6 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">字节、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Ethertype <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Control opcode <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">各<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 2 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">字节、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">26 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">字节填充与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 4 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">字节<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CRC<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="309" height="302.229" id="9" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261021150134268-1372588819.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 9<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">PFC<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的工作机制</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">拥塞控制：从 ECN、QCN、DCTCP 到 DCQCN</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">流量控制解决<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">点对点不丢包<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，拥塞控制则从源头压制拥塞。传统拥塞控制技术形成一个家族：流量控制层面的以太<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> PAUSE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> PFC<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">；拥塞控制层面的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ECN<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">QCN<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">DCTCP<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，以及面向<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> RDMA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> DCQCN<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">；再加上解决流量调度不均引起拥塞的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ECMP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">负载分担与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> LAG <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">链路聚合负载分担。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ECN（显式拥塞通知）<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：流量接收端感知到网络拥塞后，通过协议报文通知发送端降低发送速率，尽早避免拥塞丢包。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ECN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">位位于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">报头<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ToS <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">字段（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">字节）的最低<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 2 bit<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，取值<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 00 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">表示报文不支持<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ECN<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">01 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">或<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 10 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">表示报文支持<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ECN<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">11 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">表示报文的转发路径上已发生拥塞。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">QCN<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：由拥塞点（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Congestion Point<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">CP<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）算法和反应点（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Reaction Point<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">RP<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）算法组成。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">CP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">是拥塞监测点，根据自己的发送缓存队列及<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> QCN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">算法计算每条拥塞控制流（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">CCF<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）的状态，不维护关于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CCF <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">或<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> RP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的任何信息，并可独立决定是否发送拥塞通告消息（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">CNM<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">RP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">算法控制<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CCF <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的发送速率，接收<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CNM <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">并据此计算发送速率。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">DCTCP（数据中心传输控制协议）<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">TCP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">已不能满足云数据中心对时延、吞吐量和网络利用率的要求，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">DCTCP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">面向商用小缓存交换机、利用<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ECN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">算法设计，目标是高突发数据源容忍度、低时延和高吞吐量。它的三方分工是：交换机是<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">信号员<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">设定缓存占用阈值<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> K<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，数据包到达时若队列缓存超过<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> K <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">就打上<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">标记；接收端是<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">通讯员<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">只有收到带<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">标志的数据包时，才在对应<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ACK <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">报文中设置<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ECN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">标志并回复；发送端是<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">指挥官<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">对报文被标记的概率<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> α <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">进行估计，每经历一个数据窗（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">RTT<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）更新一次，并按<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> α <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">调整发送窗口，避免传统<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> TCP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的粗暴降速。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">DCQCN（数据中心量化拥塞通知）<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：数据中心部署<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> RDMA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">协议后，需要一个能在高吞吐、超低时延、低<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CPU <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">开销环境中有效运行并保证零丢包可靠传输的拥塞控制算法。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">DCQCN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">融合了<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> QCN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> DCTCP<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：交换机<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">端口队列超出阈值即进行拥塞标记（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ECN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">置为<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 11<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">），标记过程由<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> WRED<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（按一定丢弃策略随机丢弃队列报文）功能完成；接收端发现报文携带<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ECN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">拥塞标记后，向源端服务器发送拥塞通知报文<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CNP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">通知降速（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">NP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">算法）；发送端收到<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CNP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">后，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">RP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">将减小当前速率<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Rc <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">并更新速率降低因子<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> α<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">表<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 9<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　数据中心拥塞控制技术对比</span></span></span></p>

<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">以太<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> PAUSE</span></span></span></p>

<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">PAUSE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">帧暂停整条链路</span></span></span></p>

<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">PFC</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">链路级流控</span></p>
</td>

</td>

<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">智能无损网络</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">回到最初的目标：数据中心网络追求<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">零丢包、低时延、高吞吐量<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。零丢包保证不产生重传时延，保障分布式高性能应用高效稳定；低时延降低计算芯片和存储介质的等待时间，提高计算和存储效率；高吞吐量满足高性能服务器对带宽的需求，减少报文排队，确保大数据传输的吞吐量。以<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> PFC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">保障链路不丢包、以<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> DCQCN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">抑制拥塞、以<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ECMP/LAG <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">均衡流量，以太网由此从<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">有损<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">走向<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">智能无损<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，支撑<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> AI <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与大数据时代的算力互连。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">课程要点回顾</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">数据中心是<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">硬件<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> + <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">配套<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> + <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">管理<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的综合体，涵盖<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> L0<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">～<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">L4 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">五层架构，核心作用是支撑数据存储、计算与传输；</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">数据中心发展呈现四大趋势：走向服务化、走向混合云、走向多地多中心、算力密度持续升级；</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">传统三层架构因不支持大二层、无法适配占比<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 90% <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的东西向流量而逐步淘汰；</span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Spine-Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">基于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 3 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">级<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CLOS <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">架构简化而来，以全网状连接实现无阻塞转发、弹性扩展与高可靠性；</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">xSTP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与虚拟机框技术已逐步淘汰：前者收敛慢、租户有限且存在广播风暴风险，后者控制平面集中导致扩展受限、升级丢包；</span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">L2MP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">引入三层路由支持<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ECMP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">但应用受限；跨设备链路聚合解决双归接入但无法解决多租户；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">NVo3 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">以<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> VXLAN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">为核心成为当前主流；</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">物理网络中<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">分三类：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Service Leaf<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Server Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Border Leaf<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">；收敛比控制在<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 1:2<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">～<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1:9<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">推荐<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> M-LAG <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">双活，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Leaf <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Spine <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">间用三层路由接口互连并使用<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> OSPF <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">或<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> BGP<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">；</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">逻辑网络由<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Underlay <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Overlay <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">组成，两者解耦，由<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SDN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">控制器灵活部署业务；</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">RDMA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">绕过操作系统与处理器直接传输内存数据，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">RoCE v2 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">适合大规模部署，但基于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> UDP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">无重传机制、必须依赖无损网络；</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">以太<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> PAUSE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">不区分优先级，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">PFC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">以<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 8 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">个优先级队列实现选择性流控，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">DCQCN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">融合<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> QCN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> DCTCP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">保障<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> RDMA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">场景零丢包低时延，最终推动网络从<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">有损<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">迈向<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">智能无损<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
</div>
